kicker: Cervical Cancer · Int J Cancer 2026 · Multicenter Cohort
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Int J Cancer 2026 · 多中心队列
title: Clinical Utility of Cytological Methylation Assay Across Cervical Transformation Zones
title_zh: 细胞学甲基化检测在不同宫颈转化区中的临床应用价值
subtitle: 1,398 colposcopy-referred women — CISCER best in TZ-3 (sens 81.5%, AUC 0.856); 2.9 referrals per CIN3+
subtitle_zh: 1,398 例转诊阴道镜女性——CISCER 在 TZ-3 最佳（灵敏度 81.5%，AUC 0.856）；每例 CIN3+ 仅 2.9 次转诊
authors: Zhong X, Jin X, Cheng Y, Chao X, Kong L, Wang J, Liu P, Liou Y, Xin D, Lang J, Li L
authors_zh: 钟晓英, 金西桐, 程亚楠, 晁小培, 孔令华, 王婧, 刘沛, 刘雨丽, 辛德梅, 郎景和, 李雷
source: Int J Cancer 2026 · DOI 10.1002/ijc.70484
source_zh: Int J Cancer 2026 · DOI 10.1002/ijc.70484

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: cervical transformation zones (TZ-1 to TZ-3) differ in screening accuracy — TZ-3 is notoriously hard to evaluate colposcopically; methylation performance by TZ was unknown.
Question: does cytological PAX1/JAM3 methylation (CISCER) maintain diagnostic utility across TZ types?
Why it matters: an objective test that works in TZ-3 could fix the hardest-to-screen subgroup.
bullets_zh: 空白：宫颈转化区（TZ-1 至 TZ-3）筛查准确性不同——TZ-3 阴道镜评估困难；甲基化在各 TZ 的表现未明。
问题：细胞学 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化（CISCER）在各转化区类型中是否保持诊断价值？
意义：在 TZ-3 有效的客观检测可解决最难筛查的亚组。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: multicenter cohorts METHY3/METHY4 (Nov 2020–Oct 2022); Peking Union Medical College Hospital.
Population: 1,398 analyzed (1,190 with TZ classification): 283 TZ-1 / 409 TZ-2 / 498 TZ-3; 466 postmenopausal.
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); Cobas 4800; LBC.
Outcome: CIN3+ detection across TZ subgroups.
bullets_zh: 设计：多中心队列 METHY3/METHY4（2020.11–2022.10）；北京协和医院。
人群：分析 1,398 例（1,190 例有 TZ 分型）：TZ-1 283 / TZ-2 409 / TZ-3 498；466 例绝经后。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；Cobas 4800；LBC。
结局：各 TZ 亚组的 CIN3+ 检出。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: CIN3+ by TZ: overall sens 67.4%/spec 91.0% · TZ-1 72.0%/94.2% · TZ-2 48.3%/91.3% · TZ-3 81.5%/89.8%.
AUC: overall 0.792 · TZ-1 0.831 · TZ-2 0.698 · TZ-3 0.856 — all above hrHPV (0.512) and LBC (0.531).
Risk: CISCER(+) absolute CIN3+ risk 34.6% (TZ-3: 31.4%); 2.9 referrals per CIN3+.
Combination: hrHPV + CISCER dual-positive risk 34.8% with 2.9 referrals.
bullets_zh: 各 TZ 的 CIN3+：总体 灵敏度 67.4%/特异度 91.0% · TZ-1 72.0%/94.2% · TZ-2 48.3%/91.3% · TZ-3 81.5%/89.8%。
AUC：总体 0.792 · TZ-1 0.831 · TZ-2 0.698 · TZ-3 0.856——均高于 hrHPV（0.512）与 LBC（0.531）。
风险：CISCER(+) 绝对 CIN3+ 风险 34.6%（TZ-3：31.4%）；每例 CIN3+ 仅 2.9 次转诊。
联合：hrHPV + CISCER 双阳性风险 34.8%，2.9 次转诊。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: TZ-3 superiority: CISCER performed BEST where colposcopy and cytology fail most — the endocervical TZ-3.
Referral efficiency: 2.9 colposcopies per CIN3+ — far below conventional cytology referral rates.
Policy: supports methylation as the triage of choice regardless of transformation zone type.
bullets_zh: TZ-3 优势：CISCER 在阴道镜与细胞学最难处——宫颈管内 TZ-3——表现最佳。
转诊效率：每例 CIN3+ 仅 2.9 次阴道镜——远低于常规细胞学转诊率。
政策：支持甲基化作为不分转化区类型的首选分流。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Works everywhere, best in TZ-3: AUC 0.856 with 81.5% sensitivity in the hardest-to-screen zone.
2.9 referrals per CIN3+ — objective methylation triage outperforms cytology and HPV across all transformation zones.
bullets_zh: 处处有效，TZ-3 最佳：最难筛查区 AUC 0.856、灵敏度 81.5%。
每例 CIN3+ 仅 2.9 次转诊——客观甲基化分流在所有转化区中优于细胞学与 HPV。

kicker: Cervical Cancer · Clin Epigenetics 2026 · Retrospective Tissue Study
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Clin Epigenetics 2026 · 回顾性组织研究
title: PAX1/JAM3 Methylation and HPV VL in CIN3-like SCC
title_zh: CIN3样鳞状细胞癌中 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化与 HPV 病毒载量
subtitle: 138 tissue samples — CIN3-like SCC has higher HPV VL than CIN3 and early invasive SCC, but similar methylation
subtitle_zh: 138 例组织样本——CIN3样 SCC 的 HPV VL 高于 CIN3 与早期浸润 SCC，但甲基化相似
authors: Li M, Zhang X, Zhao X, Wang J, Zhao C, Zhao Y, Li J, Shen D, Wei L
authors_zh: 李明珠, 张晓博, 赵星, 王继贤, 赵超, 赵昀, 李静然, 沈丹华, 魏丽惠

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: CIN3-like SCC is a deceptive cervical cancer subtype mimicking CIN3 — its epigenetic and viral-load profile was unknown.
Question: do PAX1/JAM3 methylation and HPV VL differ between CIN3, CIN3-like SCC, early invasive and invasive SCC?
Why it matters: distinguishing CIN3-like SCC from CIN3 could prevent under-diagnosis.
bullets_zh: 空白：CIN3样 SCC 是模拟 CIN3 的隐蔽型宫颈癌——其表观遗传与病毒载量特征未知。
问题：PAX1/JAM3 甲基化与 HPV VL 在 CIN3、CIN3样 SCC、早期浸润与浸润 SCC 之间是否有差异？
意义：区分 CIN3样 SCC 与 CIN3 可防止漏诊。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: retrospective FFPE tissue study (Mar 2022–Jun 2024); Peking University People's Hospital.
Population: 65 HSIL (23 CIN2 + 42 CIN3) and 73 SCC (27 CIN3-like + 21 early invasive + 25 invasive).
Methylation: PAX1/JAM3 (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 / ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0).
Viral load: BioPerfectus BMRT multiplex PCR; VL = log10[(CnHPV/CnTOP3) × 10,000].
bullets_zh: 设计：回顾性 FFPE 组织研究（2022.3–2024.6）；北京大学人民医院。
人群：HSIL 65 例（CIN2 23 + CIN3 42）与 SCC 73 例（CIN3样 27 + 早期浸润 21 + 浸润 25）。
甲基化：PAX1/JAM3（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 / ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）。
病毒载量：BioPerfectus BMRT 多重 PCR；VL = log10[(CnHPV/CnTOP3) × 10,000]。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Cancer vs HSIL: PAX1/JAM3 methylation and total HPV VL significantly higher in SCC than HSIL (P<0.001); stepwise CIN2→CIN3→cancer.
CIN3-like vs CIN3: no methylation difference between CIN3-like SCC, early invasive and invasive SCC.
Viral load: CIN3-like SCC total HPV VL significantly higher than CIN3 and early invasive SCC (no diff vs invasive).
Correlation: methylation vs total VL: PAX1 R=−0.42 (P=2e-07), JAM3 R=−0.47 (P=4.8e-09).
bullets_zh: 癌 vs HSIL：PAX1/JAM3 甲基化与总 HPV VL 在 SCC 中显著高于 HSIL（P<0.001）；CIN2→CIN3→癌阶梯升高。
CIN3样 vs CIN3：CIN3样 SCC 与早期浸润、浸润 SCC 之间甲基化无显著差异。
病毒载量：CIN3样 SCC 的总 HPV VL 显著高于 CIN3 与早期浸润 SCC（与浸润 SCC 无差异）。
相关性：甲基化与总 VL：PAX1 R=−0.42（P=2e-07）、JAM3 R=−0.47（P=4.8e-09）。

panels.title: Clinical insight
bullets: Diagnostic trap: CIN3-like SCC looks like CIN3 histologically — 4/6 with colposcopy images had prior conization (avg 6.5 y).
Marker profile: similar methylation but higher HPV VL vs early invasive SCC — suggests a distinct biology.
Limitation: small subgroups — larger cohorts needed to confirm epigenetic/VL differences.
bullets_zh: 诊断陷阱：CIN3样 SCC 组织学酷似 CIN3——6 例有阴道镜图像者中 4 例有既往锥切史（平均 6.5 年）。
标志物特征：与早期浸润 SCC 甲基化相似但 HPV VL 更高——提示独特生物学。
局限：亚组样本小——需更大队列确认表观遗传/VL 差异。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Distinct biology: CIN3-like SCC shares methylation with invasive SCC but carries higher HPV VL — a potential discriminator.
Watch for the trap: histologically deceptive CIN3-like SCC deserves molecular scrutiny to avoid under-diagnosis.
bullets_zh: 独特生物学：CIN3样 SCC 与浸润 SCC 甲基化相似但 HPV VL 更高——潜在鉴别指标。
警惕陷阱：组织学隐蔽的 CIN3样 SCC 需分子检查以避免漏诊。
